== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|[[Jai Daishou]], also known as the [[Jai]] Patriarch, is the [[Underlord]] and leader of the [[Jai clan]], which is ranked third among the three great clans. A legendary figure, he transformed his family from a small group of barbaric factions in the [[Desolate Wilds]] into an [[Imperial]] power. He follows the [[Path of the Stellar Spear]], and his physical appearance reflects this through hair made of metallic strands. As an [[Underlord]], he possesses immense power and maintains a strict adherence to propriety and order, believing that the stability of his clan depends on his leadership. However, he is nearing the end of his life, with estimated remaining years ranging from two to five. Because the clan's survival is tied to his strength, he has focused on training disciples with extreme rigor to find a successor capable of reaching the [[Underlord]] rank. His leadership is currently challenged by internal rebellion from [[Jai Long]] and external pressures, as he struggles to maintain the clan's power while facing his own mortality.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|The [[Jai]] Patriarch is a figure of Authority{{!}}authority within the [[Jai clan]] who took the action of banishing [[Jai Long]] to the Desolate Wilds{{!}}Wilds. He currently serves as the primary target of [[Jai Long]]'s crusade.}}
